sectional_time_semantics.finding: SectionalTimes are cumulative times remaining from each distance marker to the finish.
sectional_time_semantics.basis: Adjacent cumulative differences reconcile with supplied SplitTimes.

split_time_semantics.finding: SplitTimes are individual segment times and their sum reconciles with runner race time.

six_hundred_metres_time.finding: SixHundredMetresTime represents cumulative time from the 600m marker to the finish.

two_hundred_metres_time.finding: TwoHundredMetresTime represents cumulative time from the 200m marker to the finish.

time_variation_to_winner.finding: TimeVarToWinner is supplied in hundredths of a second rather than seconds.
time_variation_to_winner.tolerance_reason: Displayed race times are rounded to hundredths.

distance_variation_to_winner.finding: DistanceVarToWinner equals runner DistanceRun minus winner DistanceRun.

distance_run.finding: DistanceRun behaves as distance travelled in metres.
distance_run.constraint: This audit validates internal differences but does not independently verify the external provider unit.

average_speed.finding: Values are preserved as source values. The precise provider calculation and unit are not asserted.

early_mid_late_speed.finding: Values are preserved as source values. The provider segment definitions and units require broader evidence.

overall_peak_speed.finding: Peak speed is preserved as a source value. Sampling interval and unit are not yet proven.

distance_from_rail.finding: DistanceFromRail is preserved as a source value. Whether it represents mean, maximum or another aggregate is not yet proven.
